definitions.explanation: A mid-altitude cloud type made up of white or gray patches and rolls, often arranged in regular groups. Popularly called ひつじ{雲|ぐも} (sheep clouds) for their woolly appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{高積雲|こうせきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Altocumulus clouds spread across the sky.

examples.japanese: {高積雲|こうせきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れ→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧やすい。
examples.english: When altocumulus clouds appear, the weather tends to turn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧、⟦{羊|ひつじ}→羊：04713_hitsuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような{高積雲|こうせきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茜色|あかねいろ}→茜色：22033_akaneiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: In the evening, altocumulus clouds like a flock of sheep were dyed crimson.

notes:
A mid-level cloud (the ⟦{積雲|せきうん}→積雲：23702_sekiun⟧ "cumulus" family at ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ "high" altitude) made of small white or gray masses. Their appearance is often read as a sign of changing weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高積雲|こうせきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: altocumulus clouds appear
- ひつじ{雲|ぐも}: sheep clouds — the everyday nickname for {高積雲|こうせきうん}

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{積乱雲|せきらんうん}→積乱雲：27194_sekiranun⟧: cumulonimbus — towering thunderclouds
- ⟦{巻積雲|けんせきうん}→巻積雲：29517_kensekiun⟧: cirrocumulus — similar ripples but much higher and finer
